Services

Inside and out.

One room or the whole house. Every estimate is free and flat.

01

Exterior painting

We paint brick, siding and trim. We scrape, caulk and prime where needed, then apply at least 2 coats of Sherwin-Williams paint.

02

Interior painting

We mask everything off first, then paint walls, ceilings, trim and more, in one room or the whole house.

03

Cabinet painting

Kitchen cabinets and bathroom vanities, even natural wood that has never been painted.

04

Staining and oiling

Fences, decks, gazebos and cedar houses, usually with Wood Defender or linseed oil.

05

Drywall and wood-rot repair

We repair and retexture drywall and replace rotten wood, from fascia boards to siding.

06

Stucco repair

Cracks and chips patched and texture-matched.

We also do:ChurchesGazebosCedar houses
